description: Execution surfaces. Resolve current_actor_type before role, workflow, or any write-capable action. Capability comes from the surface, never from prompts, roles, templates, or output contracts.
actor_model_note: These four surfaces are the only actors. There are no role-based actors. Reviewer, QA, asset creator, and security reviewer are not actors: each is a review focus, a gate, a recipient, or an issue shape running over the surfaces above. Adding an actor requires a genuinely new execution surface, never a new role. Decision record: docs/decisions/ADR-0001-actor-model.md.

entries.summary: The project owner. Sole source of write authorization, scope decisions, merges, closures, tags, releases, and settings changes.
A repository-capable agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI, or similar) operating under this kernel and the repository adapter.
entries.denied_note: Each denied action requires separate exact PM approval for that specific action; it is never implied by issue scope or mode.

entries.summary: Any browser chat surface (ChatGPT, Claude web, PM Central chat). Draft-only and no-write, regardless of role, project instructions, or PM authorization wording.
entries.denied_note: PM authorization is required for writes but never expands browser-chat capability. Browser chat routes write-capable work to a terminal surface.

entries.summary: Any surface that cannot be identified with confidence.
entries.resolution_note: Resolve to status.blocked for write-capable requests and status.needs_context for everything else.
